stem: Which sentence from the story provides the best evidence that Cassie feels insecure?

options.label: A
options.text: Overwhelmed with curiosity, I followed the sound down a narrow cobblestone walkway.

options.label: B
options.text: I slid my hands into my pockets and attempted to smile confidently.

options.label: C
options.text: A green wooden door was slightly ajar, and I peeked inside.

options.label: D
options.text: I glanced at Janis, who was quietly studying me.
